name: koah-attribution
description: UTM-based conversion attribution: demo store, tracker SDK, events API, metrics dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix pixel install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm run build:pixel
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: npm run build:pixel && concurrently -n pixel,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm --prefix pixel run watch" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix pixel run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:e2e
